Google Street View Image Glitches

Andy CASA, UCL East

As we mentioned in our post 'Google Street View - A Closer Look' the technology is subject to the cameras going out of alignment. This, combined with image flare, can create errors in the scene and a Flickr user by the name of Stallio has been grabbing screen shots to illustrate the point.
